Rotate from MSTR (crypto-levered) into pure-play software names with earnings visibility. Add on any 5% pullback; target 12-month upside of 20%+ led by enterprise SaaS and cloud security.

Regulatory tightening on mining permits and export quotas is consolidating the sector, favoring established operators with compliant land banks and logistics, a durable moat for BAJA and DSSA.
sectors.ai: Buy selective exposure to Indonesian coal and nickel names on the back of resilient domestic demand and tight thermal coal supply, but avoid chasing the crowded small-cap rally. Favor NICE and BRMS for volume growth and cost advantages, while trimming DEWA and BIPI on valuation risk. Maintain WATCH bias, as US rate volatility could cap upside; add on dips toward support levels.

themes: Indonesia's young, mobile-first population increasingly uses crypto as a savings hedge against rupiah depreciation, driving sustained retail demand for liquid large-caps like SOL and UNI.
